text: {"grades": [{"area": "contact", "level": "ok_with_setting", "reason": "Strangers can message or voice chat with the child in multiplayer, but chat can be set to 'friends only' or turned off completely.", "setting": "chat set to 'friends only' or turned off completely", "findings": ["f_10ea2db645489ab8", "f_8a83b3de676ad8b0"]}, {"area": "money", "level": "flag", "reason": "The game pushes in-app purchases through Minecoins, and children can complete purchases without parental approval, as shown by reports of kids spending birthday money and being scammed.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_4f0d24b3b6bb0948", "f_52134516877ae723"]}, {"area": "data", "level": "ok_with_setting", "reason": "The app collects data for personalized ads and may share it with third parties, but child accounts provide guardrails against some data collection and data can be deleted through account settings.", "setting": "child accounts automatically provide guardrails against the collection of some data", "findings": ["f_62d7413616ee25d9", "f_7bff118ec684f6e0"]}, {"area": "age_gating", "level": "ok_with_setting", "reason": "The age gate works in practice because multiplayer is off by default on child accounts and requires linking to a parent account for users under 16.", "setting": "multiplayer off by default on child account and linked to parent account", "findings": ["f_2ce338a674496b51", "f_ee415e54d7a54a34"]}, {"area": "content", "level": "flag", "reason": "Parents report encountering racist language in the game, such as being called the n-word, which constitutes unsuitable material for a 9-year-old.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_c9072b9921500c3f"]}, {"area": "developer_record", "level": "flag", "reason": "The developer has faced regulatory scrutiny and fines related to privacy practices, including illegal collection and retention of children's data by Microsoft.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_de8b2f2e9b3dc91e", "f_796e7220c1a87086"]}]}
